credentials_use.description: Use Your Credentials lets the agents of this conversation list, read, save, replace and remove your saved credentials, and ask you for new ones.

host_use.description: Use Your Devices lets the agents of this conversation run commands as you on any of your devices and the Cloud, move this conversation to one, pair a computer with your account, and add and remove port forwards, which outlive this conversation.

providers_manage.description: Add, change and remove your provider entries and their models, which every conversation of yours can use.

agent_profiles.description: Create, edit and delete the subagent profiles every conversation of yours can use.

agent_workflow.description: Choose the workflow this conversation works with, as the composer’s Workflow menu does.
